Results.initial_configuration: Validator V4 at key version 1, then revoked, then replaced at version 2.
execution_log: V4 is registered at key version 1 and can authenticate a vote.
Version 1 signature before revocation: Authenticated.
Authorised revocation sets V4 to REVOKED.
Same signature after revocation: Unknown, disabled or revoked validator.
A replacement key is registered as version 2.
Version 2 signature: Authenticated.
Version 1 signature after rotation: Outdated key version.
Results.security_impact: Messages authenticated with the revoked version were rejected.
Results.mitigation: Revoke the key version and require the replacement version for later votes.

Results.initial_configuration: Three acceptors. A value was chosen, then every acceptor lost durable state.
execution_log: Control: three durable acceptors choose an allocation.
Proposer ballot 1 offers 'resource-AMB-001'. Membership 3, configured quorum 2.
A1 promises ballot 1 and reports accepted value 'none'.
A2 promises ballot 1 and reports accepted value 'none'.
A3 promises ballot 1 and reports accepted value 'none'.
A1 accepts 'resource-AMB-001' at ballot 1.
A2 accepts 'resource-AMB-001' at ballot 1.
A3 accepts 'resource-AMB-001' at ballot 1.
Chosen 'resource-AMB-001' with 3 acceptors.
Fault: every acceptor loses the promised ballot and the accepted value from durable storage.
Proposer ballot 2 offers 'resource-FIRE-009'. Membership 3, configured quorum 2.
A1 has no durable promised or accepted state. Unsafe to continue.
Results.security_impact: Continuing after total loss of accepted state could choose a conflicting value.
Results.mitigation: Stop when durable promised or accepted state is missing.

Results.initial_configuration: Three acceptors, quorum 2, two acceptors unavailable.
execution_log: Fault: two of three acceptors are unavailable, so a majority cannot be contacted.
Proposer ballot 1 offers 'resource-POL-001'. Membership 3, configured quorum 2.
A1 promises ballot 1 and reports accepted value 'none'.
A2 is unavailable and sends no promise.
A3 is unavailable and sends no promise.
Prepare failed: 1 promise(s), quorum is 2. No value is chosen.
Results.security_impact: Availability: no allocation value was chosen.
Results.mitigation: Do not report a value as chosen without a majority of promises and accepts.

Results.initial_configuration: Three acceptors with quorum incorrectly set to 4.
execution_log: Fault: quorum is configured as 4 while only 3 acceptors are members.
Proposer ballot 1 offers 'resource-AMB-002'. Membership 3, configured quorum 4.
Configuration rejected: the quorum must be a majority and cannot exceed membership.
No acceptor stored a value after the configuration check failed.
Results.security_impact: An impossible quorum would stall or, if set below a majority, could break safety.
Results.mitigation: Reject a quorum that is not a majority of the current membership.

Results.initial_configuration: Three Raft nodes. A value commits while connected, then each node is isolated.
execution_log: Control: all three nodes can communicate.
R1 increments to term 1 and votes for itself.
R2 grants its vote to R1 in term 1.
R3 grants its vote to R1 in term 1.
R1 becomes leader with 3 of 3 votes (quorum 2).
R1 appends 'incident-status-verified' at index 1 in term 1.
R2 stores 'incident-status-verified'.
R3 stores 'incident-status-verified'.
Committed 'incident-status-verified' at index 1 with 3 of 3 copies.
Fault: each node is placed in its own partition, so no side holds a majority of the three-node membership.
R1 appends 'incident-status-closed' at index 2 in term 1.
R2 does not acknowledge the entry.
R3 does not acknowledge the entry.
Not committed: 1 copy(ies), quorum is 2.
Results.security_impact: The isolated leader could not commit a newer incident status.
Results.mitigation: Commit only after a majority of the configured membership stores the entry.
